runtime_generated_glyph_compatibility.reason: The executable can synthesize punctuation codes after text loading, including direct keyword-popup title wrappers. Static corpus scans cannot prove these stock glyph slots unused, so colliding Chinese assignments move to safe default-width aliases.

sound_select_title_glyph_compatibility.reason: The 101 sound-select track titles remain byte-exact Japanese. Chinese assignments that changed those stock code meanings move to safe default-width alias slots, and every title code is removed from the future allocation candidate pool.

manual_surface_evidence.library_name: 古连泰沙的连显示正常

issue_017_physical_safe_primary_migratio.reason: Use physical default-width glyph slots released by two redundant story/library-only aliases. This removes the executable extended-table dependency that allowed a new COMPDATA and stale SLPS to render 尘 as a blank.

cjk_safe_primary_normalization.reason: Keep each CJK character's existing default-width surface code as its sole canonical current-output mapping. Vacated conditional-width and raw-trail primary slots stay unused and are not future allocation candidates.

surface_sensitive_font_rebalance.policy: Default-width is mandatory for unit names, pilot and speaker names, and part names. Conditional-width codes are allowed only for characters confined to story dialogue, battle dialogue, system dialogue, or library text. Raw-trail gaps remain forbidden.

removed_duplicate_safe_compatibility.reason: Preserve original structural runtime fields that still encode the stock Japanese character 陸 while rendering the localized simplified form 陆.

clean_default_width_cjk_primary_migratio.reason: Use stock 0x889F+ default-width slots for every non-stock assignment formerly occupying 0x8140..0x8491. The complete low zone is restored from the retail ISO and the stock renderer remains unpatched.

issue_038_special_command_default_width_.reason: The command labels retain their original logical cell counts. Only the two conditional-width Chinese glyphs move to unique 0x889F+ default-width slots.

issue_037_raw_land_primary_swap.reason: Runtime-generated movement fields still emit the stock 陸 code. Restore that physical slot as the sole primary for simplified 陆 and move 硅 to the vacated default-width slot.
